original_test_intent: Read the intended BMC Device GUID in-band and establish an unambiguous canonical identity without changing BMC or inventory state.
original_method: Run raw 0x06 0x08 on the verified host, validate completion and 16-byte response, normalize the vendor/IPMI byte order and compare it with the approved BMC identity reference.
manual_activity: No per-run manual step is necessary; owner approves GUID byte-order/reference rules and reviews mismatches.
required_inputs: GUID response layout and byte order
safety_requirements: Do not use sshpass or disable host identity checking.
Do not clear logs or update inventory.
Do not silently accept a changed GUID.
No retry with a different command.
agent_execution_scope: Issue one bounded raw GUID query.
Validate completion/length and decode canonical GUID with recorded schema.
Compare to reference and return evidence without inventory mutation or DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve byte order and authoritative identity reference.
Own final verdict and any inventory change separately.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: High-level `mc guid` may be supplemental correlation, but it does not by itself evidence raw completion/length. Unsafe SSH is rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected local or verified host execution of `ipmitool raw 0x06 0x08`, retain exact bytes and parse to canonical GUID.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Raw 0x06 0x08, host-on condition, Script and 10/5-minute values are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Exact raw GUID collection, canonical decode and immutable identity comparison.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Project host with in-band access to the intended BMC.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Pin BMC, interface, ipmitool and parser schema.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor/IPMI GUID encoding plus Project inventory reference.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds secure transport and deterministic identity validation without changing the source operation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: High-level mc guid is correlation only unless raw equivalence is proven.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An endian error can associate evidence with the wrong BMC identity.

project_override_considerations: An approved library can replace CLI invocation if it retains raw completion and all 16 bytes; a normalized-only API must document equivalence to the original raw path.
expected_evidence: Tool/parser/schema versions and exact redacted raw bytes
Inventory/OOB comparison, no-mutation audit and engineer verdict

review_improvement: Produces reproducible identity evidence and prevents byte-order mistakes or silent inventory mutation.
